On browsers honoring the 2009 flexbox spec (older Android/BlackBerry WebKit that Discourse's prefixed output targets), the header panel's ordinal group of 3 without siblings 1 and 2 assigned makes its position implementation-defined, so logged-in and logged-out header controls render in the wrong slot for those users.

records.issue_text: [BUG] Converting .contents to a flex container without flex-wrap breaks the header's overflow behavior: flex items default to nowrap, so a long .title truncates/squeezes the .panel and .extra-info-wrapper onto one shrunken row instead of wrapping as the old float layout did. On topics with long titles on narrow viewports, the title text overflows or compresses the panel (hamburger/avatar) because nowrap flex items shrink to min-content rather than dropping to the next line like floated elements did.
records.rationale: In `header.scss`, `.contents` is changed from a normal block containing floated children to a flex container via `@include flexbox();` and `@include align-items(center);` while `.title { float: left; }` is removed and `.panel { float: right; }` is removed in favor of `margin-left: auto;` and `@include order(3);`. No `flex-wrap` is added, so the flex container defaults to `flex-wrap: nowrap`, meaning long flex items can force other items to shrink/compress instead of dropping/wrapping like float-based layout often would when space is insufficient. records.issue_text: [BUG] Right-aligning .panel via `margin-left: auto` only works under the standard flexbox spec; in the 2009 old-spec engines the same mixin enables (`display: -webkit-box` / `-moz-box`), auto margins do not pack items — the old spec requires -webkit-box-pack — so .panel sits immediately after the title instead of flush right on old WebKit/Firefox builds the mixin explicitly targets. Users on the legacy-flexbox browsers this mixin set claims to support (old Android WebKit, Firefox <22) get the panel glued to the title with no right alignment, a visual regression versus the removed `float: right` which worked everywhere.
records.rationale: In header.scss, `.contents` was changed from float-based layout to `@include flexbox();` and `.panel` was changed from `float: right;` to `margin-left: auto;` with `@include order(3);`. records.issue_text: [ADVISORY] Setting `.small-action` to `align-items(center)` applies vertical centering to every descendant including the custom-action buttons inside `.small-action-desc`, changing alignment of action buttons that the old padding-based layout positioned at the top. Small-action entries whose description contains a button (e.g. topic closing with a reopen button) get the button vertically centered relative to the avatar, a visual shift for all small-action content not considered by this diff.
